allocation_rule: Stratify on the silver-standard reference label. Give each stratum min(minimum_per_label, N_h) observations; allocate all remaining sample slots approximately in proportion to N_h among strata with remaining capacity using iterative floor allocation followed by a largest-remainder step with a stable lexical tie-break; then draw n_h observations without replacement within each stratum using NumPy PCG64 with the recorded random seed.
